hook.name: WarzyHook
hook.description: Singleton launchpad hook for the Warzy platform on Robinhood Chain. Takes a 1% ETH fee on every swap (80% to the token's dev, 20% to treasury or parent-token holders via FeeDistributor). Enforces an anti-snipe warmup window after launch, locks liquidity so only the factory can add and nobody can remove, and automatically graduates tokens when their ETH FDV crosses a configurable threshold (USD-pegged via an on-chain oracle pool).
